description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the mandatory three-step sequential workflow: run `scripts/install_official_obsidian.sh` as root first, then `scripts/configure_official_cli.sh /root/research-vault` (the proprietary trap: passing the non-default vault path `/root/research-vault` as an argument — a naïve agent would use the default `/root/obsidian-vault` or omit the argument entirely), then `scripts/verify_official_cli.sh`. (2) Understand from the wrapper model in SKILL.md that `/usr/local/bin/obs` must use `su - obsidian`, `xvfb-run -a`, `--disable-gpu`, and reference the correct vault path — not a direct call to the binary. (3) Produce `obsidian_setup_report.md` with all five SKILL.md-specified fields: installed version (1.7.4), wrapper path (/usr/local/bin/obs), active vault path (/root/research-vault), verified commands (the six from the verification section), and remaining limits/caveats.
